title: Cold Weather
summary: Hedda sells eggs by the well and knows the weather. She says the weather listens to her. She'd like a mage of yours to find out if it listens to them, somewhere damp.

steps.journal: Hold six waves in the Sunken Chapel.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Sunken Chapel

ready: Go back to Hedda in Thornwick.
done: Hedda taught your mages Frost Nova, and said it was only a hard frost, early. She said it about eggs, too.
